name: tracker-model-pins-and-costs
goal: Accept explicitly named Fable pins for every Tracker project and report comparable Codex API-equivalent costs from retained usage.

evidence: An explicit Fable pin should be project-independent. Saved Codex token totals should produce API-equivalent estimates or ranges when pricing is known.
Catalog coverage asserted the old allowlist, the CLI fixture exercised only a Sol pin, and the report and shared run-record cases treated all Codex usage as unpriced.
